'''Naboo''' was the healthy, main sequence [[Star/Legends|yellow star]] of the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], sharing its name with the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Naboo/Legends|third]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

==Destruction attempt==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Kul Teska]] built a [[gravitic polarization beam]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]]. He wanted to demonstrate the power of his [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] by attempting to destroy the Naboo [[Star/Legends|star]]. This attempt failed when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] sabotaged a [[Power converter/Legends|power converter]] as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Teska.
